subject: Decision: Early Offer Window & Headcount Sweep for Summer Returns
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Decision: Early Offer Window & Headcount Sweep for Summer Returns

Team —

Quick summary: we finished intern evaluations last week. There are 12 high-performing summer interns flagged by managers for return offers. I am proposing an "early offer" window (Dec 1–8) to lock top talent before competitors and to simplify onboarding scheduling.

Requests:
- Headcount: authorize +8 conversion slots above baseline campus commit (we currently have 4 baseline conversions).
- Comp bands: temporary uplift for 4 SWE interns from L3 to L4 pending manager sign-off (see attached matrix).
- Process: if approved, Recruiting will push offers using the attached offer template and we will apply the comp uplift for the 4 named profiles.

Attached: 2026_return_offer_matrix.xlsx (candidate list + manager recs), comp_impact_estimate_2026Q4.pdf (budget delta).

Decision needed by COB Mon 11/23 to meet Recruiting timelines. If you need any numbers broken out by team, I can add them to the sheet.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Manager, University Recruiting
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: 2026_return_offer_matrix.xlsx, comp_impact_estimate_2026Q4.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Decision: Early Offer Window & Headcount Sweep for Summer Returns

Aditya —

Thanks for the quick note and for pulling the attachments together. A couple quick clarifying questions before I sign off:

1) For the +8 conversion slots, can you break down by org (SWE / Infra / Applied ML)? I want to confirm with the hiring managers that we are not double-counting pending headcount for Q1.
2) The 4 uplifts to L4: are those permanent level placements or a temporary band for offer competitiveness? That affects total comp / FY run rate.

If you can drop a one-line breakdown into the sheet (column: org / permanent_level_change Y/N / hiring_manager), I can fast-track approvals.

Also CC'ing People Ops (Karthik) and Comp (Neha) so they can chime in on runway.

—Marissa
Head of Campus Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Decision: Early Offer Window & Headcount Sweep for Summer Returns

Marissa / Aditya —

I reviewed the attached comp impact estimate and ran the numbers against our current FY budget. High-level:

- Permanent conversions (8 slots) estimated incremental OTE impact: ~$180,000 annualized across orgs (headcount + benefits).
- Level uplifts (4 interns from L3 to L4): incremental delta ~$72,000 annualized.
- One-time sign-on / relocation budget: please provide a candidate-level ask if you expect sign-on > standard.

Budget routing: route increment to org_code CH-3 (Campus Hiring reserves) for Q4/Q1 allocation. People Ops will reconcile in the Dec headcount sweep.

Conditions / notes:
- If any uplift is meant to be temporary (i.e., offer band higher but level reverts after 6 months), we need an explicit manager commitment and a calibration note for future performance review.
- We can accommodate the Dec 1–8 offer window if approvals complete by Mon COB 11/23.

Approving in principle pending Marissa's confirmation on org split.

Neha Kapoor
VP, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Decision: Early Offer Window & Headcount Sweep for Summer Returns

Team —

Greenlight. Approved: +8 conversion slots (distributed as 5 SWE, 2 Infra, 1 Applied ML) and uplift for 4 SWE interns to L4 (permanent placements).

Action items:
- Aditya: update the return_offer_matrix with the org split and mark which uplifts are permanent.
- Marissa / Recruiting: proceed with Dec 1–8 offer window. Use offer_template_summer.docx and copy Legal on final language.
- Karthik / People Ops: reserve CH-3 funds and confirm payroll setup for the conversions effective 2027-01-03.
- Neha: we will accept the comp delta as outlined; please flag any suspects during reconciliation.

Aditya, please loop in Amber Lee (talent partner) if we want an external rush hire coordinator for quick turnaround.

Thanks — Vivek
SVP, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference
